question: Disambiguate whether actor-head changes, recurrent representations, or their interaction are sufficient for the observed real-reward loss of an initially competent continuous history policy under PPO.

hypotheses.selected_initial_positive_control: Previously selected seed 4507 is explicitly nonindependent; admit causal damage analysis only if new heldout initial return >=150, and full PPO loses >=25 reward points.
hypotheses.independent_new_controls: New seeds 4741 and 4759 can establish whether decomposition generalizes; do not claim broad generalization on the historically selected 4507 alone.
hypotheses.component_sufficiency: If an actor-only or recurrent-only arm loses >=25 original-source reward relative to same no-update initial policy on new heldouts, that component's trainable update is sufficient for damage under equal training budgets; if both lose, both are individually sufficient; if neither loses but full PPO does, interaction hypothesis supported. This is not identical on-policy trajectory isolation.
hypotheses.component_protective: When full PPO demonstrably damages a competent initialization, frozen-recurring actor-only or frozen-actor recurrent-only should retain at least initial-20 while beating full PPO by >=25 in both fresh original and unseen physics variants; avoid claims if initial competence is low.
hypotheses.reward_skill_acquisition: Any architecture improvement is separately held to original-source >=150 in all three seeds plus both unseen source pole conditions >=100 and >=25 above full PPO, while fully qualified two-frame conventional non-neural control remains reported.

training.actor_head_only_ppo: Freeze GRU recurrent parameters; train actor head and critic head. This isolates actor updates while critic remains trainable; full PPO loss and optimizer cadence unchanged.
training.recurrent_only_ppo: Freeze actor-head weights; train recurrent GRU parameters and critic head. This isolates recurrent representation updates with fixed actor head; full PPO loss/cadence unchanged.
training.critic_only_frozen_policy: Freeze all recurrent and actor weights, train only critic head on actual rewards; must reproduce no-update greedy actions and real-source rewards bit-for-bit.
training.full_actor_recurrent_ppo: Original P20 reward-only clipped PPO actor+critic loss, train GRU plus both actor and critic heads. No anchored KL, no altered PPO objective.
training.not_equal_trainable_parameter_counts: Trainable parameter counts differ by deliberate component isolation and must be reported; same real env action budgets and minibatch optimizer update counts, but compute comparability is not exact.

frozen_rules.fully_trained_conventional_baseline_not_: Report original fully qualified 2-frame rule-based 200 source baseline; it is a nonlearned source feedback controller, not a trained neural competitor.
